{{Top|leg}}
'''Grayfeather One''' was the callsign for the lead fighter in [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor's]] [[Grayfeather Squadron]], which used [[BTL-S8 K-wing assault starfighter|K-Wings]]. [[Caregg Oldathan]] and gunner [[Danen]] flew under the callsign during the [[Battle of Commenor (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Commenor]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]].
